festivals.what: Niihama Taiko Festival, Niihama City: mid October over four days by district (15 to 18 October in 2026), with taiko-dai (drum floats) gathering at Yamane Ground and elsewhere; the city runs free shuttles from Niihama Station.

laws.rule: Matsuyama City bans walking while smoking, and carrying a lit cigarette, in its prohibited zones: around JR Matsuyama Station; Matsuyama-shi Station, Gintengai and Okaido shopping streets, Ropeway-gai and Matsuyama Castle and Horinouchi Park; and around Dogo Onsen Honkan. The ordinance has no fine; the city may issue a formal warning. Heated tobacco is not covered. Elsewhere outdoors in the city, people are asked not to smoke while walking.

laws.rule: Ehime Youth Protection Ordinance (愛媛県青少年保護条例), art. 12 (the ordinance says "night", 夜間). The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 愛媛県青少年保護条例 (Ehime), curfew for young people

laws.rule: Ehime's 愛媛県迷惑行為防止条例 (Ehime Nuisance Acts Prevention Ordinance), art. 4, bans lewd acts in public places, including peeping at underwear or the body under clothing and using a camera to record images of them. Art. 8 bans unfair touting in public places; a breach of art. 8(2) carries a fine of up to JPY 1,000,000 (about A$9,024). The penalty for art. 4 was not extracted here. Yen at A$1 = JPY 110.82 (RBA, 30 Oct 2026).
